originalTitle: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – Overview Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
content: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time game launches November 5, 2026, exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now: ninten.do/6016asy0M The story of Link’s adventure and growth transcends time in this classic tale, built from the ground up for Nintendo Switch 2. As you venture through the Kingdom of Hyrule, you’ll meet lively characters, battle ferocious monsters, and solve puzzles scattered throughout dungeons. Use all sorts of items, including the titular ocarina, to suit your needs and forge a path forward. This title will support ZELDA NOTES, a game-specific service usable with the Nintendo Switch App for smart devices. Two new amiibo figures are also on the way; tap them to receive special in-game masks. And by tapping amiibo of characters from the Legend of Zelda games, you can get in-game items that may help you on your journey. Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot Follow Nintendo of America X/Twitter: https://twitter.com/NintendoAmerica Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/NintendoAmerica Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nintendoamerica Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/nintendo

chineseContent: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》游戏将于 2026 年 11 月 5 日在 Nintendo Switch 2 系统上独家推出。现已开放预订：ninten.do/6016asy0M 在这个经典故事中，林克的冒险和成长故事超越了时间，专为 Nintendo Switch 2 打造。当你在海拉尔王国冒险时，你会遇到活泼的角色，与凶猛的怪物战斗，并解决散布在地牢中的谜题。使用各种物品，包括名义上的陶笛，来满足您的需求并开辟前进的道路。该游戏将支持 ZELDA NOTES，这是一项可与智能设备的 Nintendo Switch 应用程序一起使用的游戏特定服务。两款新的 amiibo 玩偶也即将推出；点击它们即可获得特殊的游戏面具。通过点击《塞尔达传说》游戏中角色的 amiibo，您可以获得游戏内物品，对您的旅程有所帮助。访问 Nintendo.com 了解更多信息：https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s 订阅更多任天堂乐趣：https://goo.gl/HYYsot 关注 Nintendo of America X/Twitter：https://twitter.com/NintendoAmerica Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/NintendoAmerica Instagram：https://www.instagram.com/nintendoamerica Twitch：https://www.twitch.tv/nintendo
